values.title: Seeing in Systems
values.text: Notice connections, test assumptions, and make a small model.

values.title: What you will practice
values.text: Identify a boundary, trace one feedback loop, and explain a useful change.

## Start with a familiar system

Choose a garden, a kitchen, or a shared calendar. List the parts and draw connections between them.

**A connection matters when changing one part changes another.**

values.title: Your first model
values.items:
Name the purpose
Draw a boundary
Connect three parts
Find one feedback loop

values.title: Try the garden
values.text: Sunlight supports growth. Growth changes shade. Shade changes what can grow next.
